title: What's new
subtitle: The latest improvements to the app.

security-hardening.title: Security hardening
security-hardening.body: We tightened how sign-in redirects and the emails we send you are handled. There's nothing to do on your side — day to day, you shouldn't notice any difference.

changelog-page.title: A dedicated What's new page
changelog-page.body: The latest updates now have their own page. Open the What's new dialog and follow "See all updates" to browse the full history.

invite-no-verification.title: Joining from an invitation is quicker
invite-no-verification.body: When you sign up from an invitation link, there's no extra email to confirm — your invitation already proves your address, so you go straight into the workspace.

ai-panel.title: A richer AI panel
ai-panel.body: The assistant now lives in its own panel (toggle it with ⌘J), streams nicely formatted answers, and asks you to Confirm or Reject before it creates or changes anything.

whats-new-panel.title: Follow what's new
whats-new-panel.body: This panel lists the latest improvements. A dot on the button lets you know when something new has landed.

ai-formatting.title: Easier-to-read AI replies
ai-formatting.body: The assistant now formats its answers with lists, bold text and headings instead of plain blocks of text.

loading-skeletons.title: Smoother loading
loading-skeletons.body: Animated placeholders now appear while your dashboard and lists load.

friendly-errors.title: Clearer error screens
friendly-errors.body: If something goes wrong or a page doesn't exist, a friendly screen helps you retry or get back home.
